subject: Post-demo: Northbridge POC acceptance playbook & integration checkpoints
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Fischer <elena@northbridge.ai>, Tom Geller <tgeller@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Northbridge POC acceptance playbook & integration checkpoints

Thanks again for the time earlier — nice demo from your side, and appreciate the clear use cases. This thread is to capture the post-demo recap, proposed POC acceptance criteria, and the implementation checkpoints our SE/engineering team will track. Please review below and flag anything you want to change.

POC goal (high level)
- Validate model-led intent extraction and entity enrichment in Northbridge's transaction reconciliation flow at production-like scale.

Proposed success criteria (draft)
- Intent extraction accuracy >= 95% on a 10k sampled transactions set (F1-style metric we can agree on).
- Top-1 entity extract precision >= 93% for vendor and category fields.
- 95th percentile end-to-end latency <= 250ms for 1-2 sentence prompts in sandbox with streaming enabled.
- Throughput target: sustained 20 requests/sec with bursts to 50 req/sec during peak.
- Cost target: incremental inference cost <= $X per 1k tokens (we'll align on model/config).

Technical checkpoints we recommend for the POC
1) Sandbox credentials + sample dataset (your side) — needed to run correctness tests.
2) SE-led integration plan (Redwood) — SDK routes, streaming session handbook, function/tool calling hooks to your KG.
3) Performance baseline run (week 1) — establish latency and throughput with our default batch/caching.
4) Quality eval (week 2) — run the 10k sample through the evaluation harness.
5) Tuned run and recommendations (week 3) — quantization/batching changes and final acceptance.

Ownership & timing (proposal)
- Northbridge: deliver anonymized sample dataset + workspace access by Jul 5. (Owner: Tom)
- Redwood SE (Ben): implement SDK integration & streaming test harness by Jul 7.
- Redwood Eng (Karthik): baseline infra and perf validation by Jul 10.
- Acceptance decision: Jul 20 (final sign-off).

Practical asks for your team now
- Confirm the success criteria above or propose edits.
- Share the person who will own dataset delivery and a sandbox domain for token provisioning.
- Any constraints on outgoing network calls (for function/tool calling) we should know about?

Attachments included: nb-poc-success-metrics.csv (sample metrics template), mutual-action-plan_v1.docx (milestone doc).

Next step: If you confirm the criteria, Ben will share a short implementation checklist + SDK stubs. I can schedule a 30-min kickoff for next week (suggest Jul 7).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Tom Geller <tgeller@northbridge.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 17:10:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Northbridge POC acceptance playbook & integration checkpoints

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and proposed plan. Quick responses inline: 

- Success criteria: the accuracy/precision targets look reasonable. We can commit to providing the 10k sample (anonymized) and a small holdout set. For the cost target, we'll need a ballpark from you on model/config choices so we can assess.

- Throughput/latency: 250ms p95 is aggressive but acceptable as a stretch target for the POC. Our primary objective is quality; if we hit <350ms p95 that's okay provided the quality gates clear.

- Network/function calls: we will allow outbound calls to your function endpoints from the sandbox, but they must go through our proxy and authenticates with our internal token. No direct 3rd-party webhooks to prod services during the POC.

- Kickoff: Jul 7 works for our team — Tom and Elena to attend.

Action items from Northbridge
- I'll assign Elena to own dataset delivery and sandbox access.
- I'll loop in our infra lead for proxy details once Ben shares the expected endpoint pattern.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Geller
Director of Data Products — Northbridge Analytics
tgeller@northbridge.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Geller <tgeller@northbridge.ai>, Elena Fischer <elena@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 Jul 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Northbridge POC acceptance playbook & integration checkpoints

Tom / Elena — thanks. Below is a concise integration plan and concrete implementation steps we will execute before the Jul 7 kickoff. I'm listing owners and minimal artifacts so we can avoid surprises.

High-level approach
- We'll run a sandbox against your sample dataset with Redwood hosted sandbox model variants. Streaming will be used for early throughput-driven tests, then we'll run closed-batch passes for quality evals. For function/tool calling we will provide a small shim service that calls your KG via your proxy.

Step 0 — pre-kickoff (this week)
- Northbridge provides: anonymized 10k sample + sandbox domain + proxy auth mechanism (Owner: Elena, due Jul 5).
- Redwood provides: sandbox API key, sample eval harness, and integration checklist (Owner: Ben, due Jul 5).

Step 1 — SDK integration (Ben) — target Jul 5–Jul 7
- We will provide a Node + Python SDK example showing: 
  * route POST /v1/generate -> uses model redwood-4b-quant (default)
  * route POST /v1/streaming/generate -> SSE/HTTP2 streaming for early prefix latency tests
  * function calling hook: POST /v1/functions/kb-lookup -> stub that calls your proxy endpoint (auth: Bearer <proxy-token>)
  * KV/Prefix cache: enable prefix caching for repeated vendor names to reduce token generation.
- Example curl (sandbox):
  curl -X POST https://sandbox.api.redwood.ai/v1/streaming/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_KEY>" -d '{"model":"redwood-4b-quant","input":"<prompt>","stream":true,"max_tokens":256}'

Step 2 — perf baseline (Karthik) — Jul 8–Jul 10
- Run 3 load profiles: 1) sustained 20 req/s, 2) 50 req/s bursts (30s), 3) spike test 100 concurrent warm sessions. Collect p50/p95/p99 latencies, CPU/GPU utilization, batching stats.
- Default batch windows: 20ms (low latency) then 100ms for throughput run; we'll try aggressive batching only if latency SLAs are still met.

Step 3 — quality eval (Ben) — Jul 11–Jul 14
- Run the eval harness against the 10k sample and holdout. We'll provide a results CSV and error breakdown (false positives, missing entities).
- If intent F1 <95% we'll propose prompt + context augmentation and a trimmed reranker run.

Step 4 — tuning & final run (Team) — Jul 15–Jul 18
- Apply quantization or a larger variant if needed, adjust batch/cache policy, and re-run acceptance tests.

Owners & contact list
- Ben Carter (SE) — implementation checklist, SDK examples, streaming harness (ben.carter@redwood.ai).
- Karthik Iyer (Infra) — perf runs and infra tuning (karthik@redwood.ai).
- Marissa Cole (AE) — commercial/coordination (marissa@redwood.ai).
- Northbridge: Elena (data delivery) and Tom (stakeholder).

Attachments referenced: integration-checklist.md (detailed task list), sdk-stub.patch (quick code examples).

A couple of technical notes for your infra team:
- We'll need one outbound endpoint for the function-calling shim: https://hook.redwood.ai/nb/kb-lookup (we can swap to your proxy).
- For streaming, we support SSE and HTTP/2 chunked; SSE is easiest to start with.
- Tokenization: we recommend measuring avg tokens/prompt during baseline. If average tokens > 180 we may suggest a 1.5x cost estimate.

I'll push the checklist and SDK stubs to the shared Drive link (see thread metadata).

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0199

From: Elena Fischer <elena@northbridge.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Jul 2028 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Northbridge POC acceptance playbook & integration checkpoints

Thanks — all good from our side. Quick confirmations and next steps: 

1) Dataset & creds: I will own dataset delivery; we'll anonymize and deliver the 10k sample by EOD Jul 5 and the holdout by Jul 8. Sandbox proxy creds will be shared as a one-time token with Ben by Jul 5.

2) Kickoff meeting: Jul 7 at 10:00 AM PT works. I'll invite our infra lead and a product owner. Please share the calendar invite and a short agenda (30 min).

3) Acceptance gate flexibility: we accept the 95%/93% targets as the baseline; we reserve the right to accept up to 350ms p95 for the POC if quality targets are met. We'll iterate on cost after the baseline run.

4) Network constraints: we'll send requests to your shim via our proxy; please confirm the exact endpoint and expected header (Ben suggested Authorization: Bearer <proxy-token>).

Thanks everyone — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Elena Fischer
Head of Product — Northbridge Analytics
elena@northbridge.ai | +1 (212) 555-0444
